name: Krusch Grounded Harness MCP
description: Turn-0 workspace schema grounding, scale-aware profile resolution, read-memoized tool interception, and defect-only outer stop-gate MCP server (kruschdev/grounded-harness v0.2.1). Read-only Turn-0 grounding, scale profile lookup, and session summary inherit Guard policy; SQLite session creation, tool interception, outcome logging, and stop verification require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use krusch_ground_workspace and krusch_resolve_scale_profile to inspect CSV/JSON/SQLite workspace schemas and scale profiles without writing session rows.
Keep krusch_grounded_session_start, krusch_grounded_intercept, krusch_grounded_outcome, and krusch_grounded_verify_stop on Review because they mutate session state in the local SQLite WAL store.
Point krusch_ground_workspace only at project directories the coding agent is already authorized to read.
